lines.en: label chinamispring8:
scene chinamisnewfriend1
: Okay, Chinami. I’m putting you in charge of checking the CDs and vinyls. Grab as much as you possibly can now and I’ll be over there to double check after I scour the last of the concert DVDs.
lines.zh: : 好的，Chinami。我派你去负责检查 CD 和黑胶唱片。现在能拿多少就拿多少，等我扫完最后那批演唱会 DVD 就过去复核。

lines.en: : Then, we’ll triple and quadruple check the store before heading to the next one. Do you understand? Good. Also, ask whoever’s working if they have anything else in the back they might be hiding.
lines.zh: : 然后，在去下一家店之前，我们会把这家店再检查第三遍、第四遍。明白了吗？很好。还有，问问店员后台是不是还藏着什么别的东西。

lines.en: scene chinamisnewfriend2
: Oh! Ask about cardboard cutouts and promotional posters too! I know I’ve seen some here before! Leverage your cuteness if you have to!
lines.zh: : 哦！顺便问问有没有立牌和宣传海报！我知道我以前在这儿见过！必要的话就利用你的可爱！

lines.en: : Or, if it’s a creepy looking older person, call for {i}me{/i} so {i}I{/i} can leverage my own assets! Do you copy?!
lines.zh: : 或者，如果是个看着猥琐的年长者，就叫{i}我{/i}过来，让{i}我{/i}用自己的本钱！收到没有？！

lines.en: : Chinami wants boba. Eating sugar packets all morning has led to a dangerous addiction that she must now deal with for the rest of her life.
lines.zh: : Chinami 想喝波霸奶茶。吃了一早上的糖包，让她染上了一种危险的瘾，后半辈子都得跟它作斗争。

lines.en: : {size=-4}Niki first, boba second! I’ll buy you all the boba in the fucking world once we’ve made sure that no one else in Kumon-mi is hoarding the queen’s merch! This is the last chance we’ll ever get and it needs to be taken seriously!{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-4}先 Niki，后波霸！等我们确认 Kumon-mi 再没别人在囤女王的周边，我就给你买全世界的波霸奶茶！这是我们最后的机会了，必须认真对待！{/size}

lines.en: : Okay. Chinami will go check for CDs. But she urges big sis Chika to maybe think a little bit more about what’s happening since she did just find out Papa has been cheating on her with her favorite idol.
lines.zh: : 好的。Chinami 这就去检查 CD。但她想劝 Chika 姐姐多少想一想眼下发生了什么——她刚刚才发现 Papa 一直背着你，跟你最喜欢的偶像出轨。

lines.en: scene chinamisnewfriend3
: Oh my god. You’re right.
lines.zh: : 天啊。你说得对。

lines.en: : See?! Big sis Chika’s been going so crazy after meeting Niki that she forgot about what’s really-
lines.zh: : 看吧？！Chika 姐姐见了 Niki 之后就疯成这样，她把真正——

lines.en: scene chinamisnewfriend4
: This basically means {i}I’ve{/i} kissed her too! Among other things! {b}SO MANY OTHER THINGS.{/b} Oh my god. Oh my god, oh my god, oh my god. I shouldn’t feel this way in public, BUT I DO!
lines.zh: : 这基本上意味着「我」也吻过她了！还有其他的事！{b}好多好多别的事。{/b}天啊。天啊天啊天啊。我不该在公共场合有这种感觉，可我就是有！

lines.en: : {i}Hah...{/i}okay. Chinami will take on her mission for real now...
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}好吧。Chinami 现在真的要去执行任务了……

lines.en: scene chinamisnewfriend5
: But only because she really wants boba and-
lines.zh: : 但只是因为她真的很想喝波霸奶茶，而且——

lines.en: scene chinamisnewfriend6
: Hm?
: Nao-chan? Big sis Chika, Nao-chan is here.
lines.zh: : Nao-chan？Chika 姐姐，Nao-chan 在这儿。

lines.en: : Good! That means more hands! Get {i}her{/i} to help too! OH, TSUKASA! CALL TSUKASA! WE NEED MORE MONEY!
lines.zh: : 好！那就有更多人手了！也让{i}她{/i}来帮忙！哦，TSUKASA！叫上 TSUKASA！我们需要更多钱！

lines.en: : Nao-chan! Would you like to come help the Chosokabes check the store for-
lines.zh: : Nao-chan！你愿意来帮 Chosokabe 姐妹检查店里有没有——

lines.en: scene chinamisnewfriend7
: Now, Chinami is sad. Nao-chan left.
lines.zh: : 这下 Chinami 伤心了。Nao-chan 走了。

lines.en: : Then go get her! It’ll be worth the time investment when we can leverage {i}her{/i} cuteness too! I’ll be fine here! Go, Chinami! Go, go, go!!!
lines.zh: : 那就去追{i}她{/i}！等我们也能利用「她」的可爱时，这笔时间投资就值了！我在这儿没事！去吧，Chinami！快，快，快！！！

lines.en: scene black
: Fine! Jeez Louise, big sis Chika! It’s like {i}Chinami’s{/i} the older sister all of a sudden and she’s just not ready for that!
lines.zh: : 知道了！老天爷啊，Chika 姐姐！搞得好像{i}Chinami{/i}突然成了姐姐似的，她可还没准备好呢！

lines.en: : YOU THERE! EMPLOYEE GIRL! I know you’re hiding things from me. LET ME IN THE BACK ROOM! NOW!
lines.zh: : 那边那个！店员小姐！我知道你们在藏东西。让我进后面的房间！现在！

lines.en: scene chinamisnewfriend8
: Nao-chan, would you like to get boba with Chinami while her big sister has an episode in the music store? Chinami doesn’t have any money, but she learned something about using her {i}assets{/i} to-
lines.zh: : Nao-chan，你愿意跟 Chinami 一起去买波霸奶茶吗？趁她姐姐在音像店里发疯的时候？Chinami 没钱，不过她刚学会怎么用自己的{i}本钱{/i}来——

lines.en: : What? A magical portal? Really?
lines.zh: : 什么？一道魔法传送门？真的？

lines.en: : {i}Two{/i} magical portals? But what are they doing in the mall? Was that part of the renovation project that kept Chinami from experiencing commerce for such a long period of time?
lines.zh: : {i}两{/i}道魔法传送门？可它们为什么会在商场里？是那次让 Chinami 很长一段时间没法体验商业活动的装修工程的一部分吗？

lines.en: : {size=-6}You don’t have to tell Chinami that. She understands better than anyone that capitalism is just one more means to an end. But that doesn’t mean Chinami isn’t going to participate in it since failure to conform would only lead to a further accelerated gap in class and status.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-6}这个你不用告诉 Chinami。她比谁都清楚，资本主义不过是又一种达到目的的手段。但这不意味着 Chinami 不会参与其中，毕竟不顺应只会让阶级与地位的差距加速扩大。{/size}

lines.en: : Of course Chinami already set up a Roth IRA. What kind of fool do you take her for?
lines.zh: : Chinami 当然早就开了罗斯 IRA 账户。你把她当什么傻子了？

lines.en: scene chinamisnewfriend9
“And so a few mortals encountered two portals,” he chortled so heartily it sounded aortal.
lines.zh: 「于是，几个凡人遇见了两道门。」他咯咯地笑着，笑得那么起劲，听起来倒像主动脉在跳。

lines.en: {size=-4}One to death, one to life. One so welcoming, hell’s coming, go get your wife (then replace her piece by piece until she’s a new wife and it sparks a debate on what percentage of person a person can be until adultery becomes childtery.) JOKE. {/size}
lines.zh: {size=-4}一道通往死亡，一道通往生命。一道如此亲切，地狱就要来了，去把你老婆接来（然后一块一块地把她换掉，直到她变成一个全新的老婆，由此引发一场辩论：一个人被换掉百分之多少，通奸才能算作「童奸」。）开玩笑的。{/size}

lines.en: : Chinami is confused and bemused in determining which portal is the one we should use.
lines.zh: : Chinami 又困惑又好笑，拿不准我们该用哪一道门。

lines.en: : Really? But if they aren’t safe, why did somebody put them in the middle of the mall?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？可如果它们不安全，为什么会有人把它们放在商场正中间？

lines.en: : Chinami can read! But she’s concerned this could be one more example of false advertising since the “Death” portal looks so warm and welcoming.
lines.zh: : Chinami 认字！但她担心这可能是又一个虚假宣传的例子，因为那道「死亡」之门看起来又温暖又亲切。

lines.en: : Huh. That’s an interesting way to look at it, and one that helps Chinami better cope with the fact that she will one day be among the sunflowers.
lines.zh: : 嗯。这个看法挺有意思，也让 Chinami 更能接受自己有朝一日会躺在向日葵之间这件事。

lines.en: : She thinks she’s going to go through the “Life” portal, though. Even if it seems a little scarier than the other one. Because life is objectively better than death.
lines.zh: : 不过她觉得自己要走「生命」那道门。就算它看起来比另一道吓人一点。因为生命客观上讲比死亡好。

lines.en: : Together then? Should we maybe tie a string to something here so we can find our way back?
lines.zh: : 那一起走？我们要不要在这儿系根绳子，好找到回来的路？

lines.en: : Okay! Chinami is confident that Nao-chan knows the way, so she will follow her lead. We need to be quick, though! Big sis Chika will get mad at Chinami if she doesn’t help fuel her obsession.
lines.zh: : 好！Chinami 相信 Nao-chan 认得路，所以她跟着你走就行。不过我们得快！要是 Chinami 不去给她的执念添柴加火，Chika 姐姐会生气的。

lines.en: scene black
One step, two steps, three steps, jump.
lines.zh: 一步，两步，三步，跳。

lines.en: What fun we will have once the tree is a stump.
lines.zh: 等树变成树桩，我们该有多快活。

: No, you guys aren’t listening! I’m telling you that’s not the way it is!
lines.zh: : 不，你们没在听！我告诉你们，事情不是这样的！

lines.en: : You’ve been telling us that’s {i}not the way it is{/i} for like ten minutes now, dude.
lines.zh: : 你已经跟我们说{i}事情不是这样的{/i}说了快十分钟了，老兄。

lines.en: : But if literally {i}everyone{/i} in the room is apparently “misunderstanding” you, I’m just saying it’s possible that maybe {i}you’re{/i} the one who’s not really “getting it.”
lines.zh: : 可要是屋里{i}所有人{/i}显然都在「误解」你，我只是说，也许有可能是{i}你{/i}自己没真的「搞懂」。

lines.en: : Hailey’s right, Paul. Like, we get that she’s in heat and everything, but that doesn’t mean you can say things that...{i}forward{/i} and expect to get away with it.
lines.zh: : Hailey 说得对，Paul。比如，我们知道她发情了什么的，可那不代表你能说出那么……{i}露骨{/i}的话，还指望没事。

lines.en: : It wasn’t {i}forward{/i} at all, bro! She’s like a sister to me! You guys are just misunderstanding the context. Besides, there’s already some other girl I like. I wouldn’t-
lines.zh: : 一点都不{i}露骨{/i}啊，兄弟！她就像我妹妹一样！你们只是误解了语境。再说，我已经有别的喜欢的女孩了。我不会——

lines.en: : What, you mean Hailey?
lines.zh: : 什么，你是说 Hailey？

lines.en: : You- what?! No!
lines.zh: : 你——什么？！不是！

lines.en: : Aww, Paul. That’s cute. It’d be cuter if you weren’t such an asshole, sure. But I’m glad that your heart is at least functional enough to have feelings for somebody at the end of the day.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，Paul。真可爱。当然，你要不是个混蛋就更可爱了。不过我很高兴，你的心脏好歹还够用，一天到晚还能对谁有点感觉。

lines.en: : My heart is perfectly functional!
lines.zh: : 我的心脏好用得很！

lines.en: : Care to weigh in Octavia? You’ve got three hearts, don’t you?
lines.zh: : Octavia 要说两句吗？你有三颗心脏，不是吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, and four boyfriends. Why does she need to weigh in at all?
lines.zh: : 对，还有四个男朋友。她凭什么要发表意见啊？

lines.en: : {size=-2}We broke up like a year ago, Paul. Get over it already. But yes, as the one person here who’s been unfortunate enough to actually {i}date{/i} this guy, I can confirm that he {i}does{/i} have feelings. Sometimes.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}我们一年前就分手了，Paul。你该放下了。不过没错，作为这里唯一一个不幸真的跟这家伙「约会」过的人，我可以确认他「确实」有感情。有时候有吧。{/size}

lines.en: : {i}Sometimes?!{/i} When did I ever-
lines.zh: : {i}有时候？！{/i}我什么时候——

lines.en: scene chinamisnewfriend12
: Wait, Paul. Hold on.
lines.zh: : 等等，Paul。先等一下。

lines.en: : Hey! You over there. Are you new here?
lines.zh: : 嘿！那边那个。你是新来的吗？

lines.en: scene chinamisnewfriend10

lines.zh: : 我……我吗？

lines.en: : Yeah! What are you just standing around for? Come hang out with us. We won’t bite.
lines.zh: : 对啊！你站着干嘛呢？过来跟我们一起玩吧。我们又不咬人。

lines.en: : Unless you {i}want{/i} us to.
lines.zh: : 除非你「{i}想{/i}」我们咬。

lines.en: : See, this is exactly why everyone’s always talking shit on you. There’s no way that girl’s even sexually mature yet.
lines.zh: : 瞧，这就是大家老说你坏话的原因。那女孩搞不好都还没性成熟呢。

lines.en: : She’s a dog, isn’t she? Don’t they hit sexual maturity at, like...six months sometimes?
lines.zh: : 她是只狗吧？它们不是大概……六个月就性成熟了吗？

lines.en: : You think {i}that’s{/i} impressive? Bees hit it at six {i}days.{/i} Hi, new girl! I’m Beatrice! Tell us your name and body count!
lines.zh: : 你觉得{i}那个{/i}厉害？蜜蜂六{i}天{/i}就成了。嗨，新来的！我叫 Beatrice！报上你的名字和床伴数！

lines.en: : My...body count? What does...that mean?
lines.zh: : 我的……床伴数？那是……什么意思？

lines.en: : Ignore them. Come chat! We’re just getting ready for the Transpacific Sadness Symposium in a few years. There’s no need to be shy!
lines.zh: : 别理他们。过来聊聊！我们正准备几年后的跨太平洋悲伤研讨会呢。不用害羞！

lines.en: : There goes Hailey jumping at the first chance she gets to flirt with a dog again.
lines.zh: : Hailey 又来了，一有机会就跟狗调情。

lines.en: : Oh, right. Lamar is here. Thank you for chiming in, Lamar. Your opinion was both needed and wanted.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。Lamar 在这儿。谢谢你的高见，Lamar。你的意见既被需要，又受欢迎。

lines.en: : He’s got a point though, Hailey. You {i}do{/i} have a type.
lines.zh: : 不过他说得有道理，Hailey。你{i}确实{/i}有偏好。

lines.en: scene chinamisnewfriend13
: I do not! I just remember when {i}I{/i} was new and Howard was always going out of his way to include me in stuff. Feeling left out {i}sucks.{/i} We can all agree on that, right?
lines.zh: : 我才没有！我只是记得{i}我{/i}刚来的时候，Howard 总是特意拉我一起玩。被冷落{i}很不好受{/i}。这点大家总该同意吧？

lines.en: : {i}Dogs,{/i} Hailey? Really?
lines.zh: : {i}狗{/i}，Hailey？真的吗？

lines.en: : It’s the 21st century, Paul. Try checking your bigotry at the door next party.
lines.zh: : 都二十一世纪了，Paul。下次派对麻烦把你的偏见寄存在门口。

lines.en: : Octavia fucked a dog once.
lines.zh: : Octavia 跟狗搞过一次。

lines.en: : It was a lot more than once.
lines.zh: : 可不止一次。

lines.en: : Uh...actually, I...I don’t think I’m supposed to be here...
lines.zh: : 呃……其实，我……我想我不该在这儿……

lines.en: : I need to be...helping my sister with something...
lines.zh: : 我得……帮姐姐做事……

lines.en: : You have a sister? Is it just one? I have thirteen. Come talk! I want to get to know you.
lines.zh: : 你有姐姐？就一个？我有十三个。过来聊聊！我想了解你。

lines.en: : Oh, here we go again. Manic pixie Hailey is back in action to swipe some newcomer off her feet.
lines.zh: : 哦，又来了。精灵少女 Hailey 又上线了，要把新来的迷得神魂颠倒。

lines.en: : Seriously, Lamar. Shut up. You barely know me.
lines.zh: : 说真的，Lamar。闭嘴吧。你根本不了解我。

lines.en: scene chinamisnewfriend14
: So...your name is Hailey?
lines.zh: : 那么……你叫 Hailey？

lines.en: : Hailey Hawthorne. I’m from Michigan. What about you? What’s your name? What’s your story?
lines.zh: : Hailey Hawthorne。我来自密歇根。你呢？你叫什么名字？你有什么故事？

lines.en: : Chinami Chosokabe. I’m from Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : Chinami Chosokabe。我来自 Kumon-mi。

lines.en: : Kumon-mi? Is that in Massachusetts or something?
lines.zh: : Kumon-mi？那是在马萨诸塞还是什么的？

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure that’s Japan, actually. Kumon-mi’s that city they blocked off from the rest of the world during that extremely isolated space war a few years back.
lines.zh: : 我挺确定那其实是在日本。Kumon-mi 就是几年前那场极度与世隔绝的太空战争期间，被从世界其他地方封锁起来的那座城市。

lines.en: : Oh my god, {i}Japan?{/i} That’s so far! When did you get to America? Are you here for long or what?
lines.zh: : 天啊，{i}日本{/i}？那也太远了！你什么时候来美国的？你要待很久还是怎样？

lines.en: : I don’t know. I went through a portal in the mall with my friend Nao-chan and suddenly I was here. Do you know how to get back?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我跟朋友 Nao-chan 在商场里穿过一道传送门，然后我就到这儿了。你知道怎么回去吗？

lines.en: : I think you’d need to buy a plane ticket. Are planes even going to that Kumon-mi place if they’re blocked off, though?
lines.zh: : 我觉得你得买张机票。不过既然那里被封锁了，飞机真的会飞去那个 Kumon-mi 吗？

lines.en: : Octavia, you’re the smart one here. Do you know if there’s another one of those portal things Chinami could take back home after the party? You {i}are{/i} staying for the party. Right, Chinami?
lines.zh: : Octavia，你是这里最聪明的。你知道派对结束后，Chinami 能不能搭别的那种传送门回家吗？你{i}会{/i}留下参加派对的。对吧，Chinami？

lines.en: scene chinamisnewfriend15
: I’m not really supposed to go to parties. I get sick really easily and big sis Chika says they’re a breeding ground for germs.
lines.zh: : 我其实不该参加派对。我特别容易生病，Chika 姐姐说那是细菌的温床。

lines.en: : Do you not get out much then?
lines.zh: : 那你很少出门咯？

lines.en: scene chinamisnewfriend16
: Basically never. I’m not even allowed to go to school. I just sit at home all day and watch TV.
lines.zh: : 基本从不出门。我连学校都不让去。我整天就坐在家里看电视。

lines.en: : Wait, so is this your first party {i}ever?{/i} Do you drink? I can show you where the cooler is.
lines.zh: : 等等，那这是你{i}有生以来第一次{/i}参加派对？你喝酒吗？我可以带你看冰柜在哪儿。

lines.en: : Do you have apple juice? I’m addicted to sugar now.
lines.zh: : 你们有苹果汁吗？我现在对糖上瘾了。

lines.en: : Howard should. He’s an addict too. Are you sure you need that, though? You’re so young. You’re going to ruin your skin.
lines.zh: : Howard 应该有。他也是个瘾君子。不过你确定要喝吗？你这么小。会把皮肤搞坏的。

lines.en: : I can call someone if you’re serious. Not here, though. And you didn’t hear that from me.
lines.zh: : 你要是真想要，我可以帮人打电话。不过不在这儿。还有，这话可不是我说的。

lines.en: : On second thought, Chinami should probably-
lines.zh: : 再想想，Chinami 大概还是——

lines.en: scene chinamisnewfriend17
: Mm!
lines.zh: : Mm!

lines.en: : Hm? Something wrong?
lines.zh: : 嗯？怎么了？

lines.en: : Did you just accidentally speak in the third person? Oh my god, that’s precious! I love her.
lines.zh: : 你刚才不小心用第三人称自称了？天啊，太可爱了！我爱她。

lines.en: : I...have a bad habit of doing that sometimes...I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 我……我有时候有这个坏习惯……抱歉。

lines.en: : Why are you apologizing? Just be yourself, Chinami. Hailey thinks that’s the cool thing to do.
lines.zh: : 为什么要道歉？做你自己就好，Chinami。Hailey 觉得那样才酷。

lines.en: scene chinamisnewfriend18
: It’s just...a little embarrassing. Ch...I’ve never been around cool, older kids before. All of my big sister’s friends are kind of lame and weird.
lines.zh: : 只是……有点不好意思。C……我从没跟酷一点的大孩子待过。我姐姐那些朋友都有点又无聊又怪。

lines.en: : You think we’re cool? Really?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我们酷？真的？

lines.en: : Don’t get too excited. Dogs love everybody.
lines.zh: : 别太得意。狗对谁都亲。

lines.en: : Especially Octavia.
lines.zh: : 尤其是 Octavia。

lines.en: : You should try one too, Beatrice. I know this German shepherd who’s really into bugs. I could give you his number if you want.
lines.zh: : 你也该试试，Beatrice。我认识一只德国牧羊犬，特别迷虫子。你要的话，我可以给你他的号码。

lines.en: : I don’t know...Like, don’t get me wrong, it sounds {i}hot.{/i} But look at me. I’m probably like...one twentieth of his size.
lines.zh: : 我不知道……别误会，听起来是挺{i}带感{/i}的。可你看我。我大概……只有他的二十分之一大。

lines.en: : Well, duh. Why do you think he’s into bugs in the first place?
lines.zh: : 那还用说。不然你以为他为什么一开始就迷虫子？

lines.en: : Oh. So he’s one of {i}those.{/i}
lines.zh: : 哦。所以他是{i}那种人{/i}。

lines.en: : You haven’t answered my question yet. You really think we’re cool?
lines.zh: : 你还没回答我的问题呢。你真觉得我们酷？

lines.en: : Chinami learned from TV that parties are for cool kids normally. Is that not true?
lines.zh: : Chinami 从电视上学的，派对一般都是酷小孩去的。不是这样吗？

lines.en: : You did the thing again.
lines.zh: : 你又来了。

lines.en: : Paul, shh. Leave her alone. This is basically a brand new {i}world{/i} for Chinami. Who cares how she speaks?
lines.zh: : Paul，嘘。别管她。对 Chinami 来说，这基本是个全新的「{i}世界{/i}」。她怎么说话有什么关系？

lines.en: : Thank you, Hailey. I really {i}do{/i} need to leave, though. My sister’s going to be really mad that I left her at the mall.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Hailey。不过我真的{i}得{/i}走了。我把姐姐丢在商场，她会很生气的。

lines.en: scene chinamisnewfriend19
: Assuming she even remembers I exist right now and it isn’t too busy shopping...
lines.zh: : 前提是她这会儿还记得我存在，而且没忙着购物……

lines.en: : Well hey, one little sister to another, I’ve learned to accept that we’re not {i}always{/i} going to be the top priority. Everybody needs space sometimes. Even family.
lines.zh: : 嘿，以一个妹妹对另一个妹妹说的话——我学会了接受我们{i}并不总是{/i}会被放在第一位。有时候人人都需要空间。哪怕是家人。

lines.en: : Besides, it’s too late to get a plane ticket out of here. I can drive you to the airport in the morning if you want. And you can crash at my place in the meantime. It’s nearby.
lines.zh: : 再说，现在想买机票离开也太晚了。你要是愿意，明早我可以开车送你去机场。这期间你可以先在我家凑合一晚。就在附近。

lines.en: scene chinamisnewfriend20
: Is there really no portal back to Japan? Because I’m worried about Nao-chan too. She can’t speak and it might be harder for her to make friends. Nobody is gonna drive {i}her{/i} to the airport.
lines.zh: : 真的没有回日本的传送门吗？因为 Chinami 也担心 Nao-chan。{i}她{/i}不会说话，可能更难交到朋友。也没人会开「她」去机场。

lines.en: : Is Nao-chan your...girlfriend? Or just a regular friend who also happens to be a girl?
lines.zh: : Nao-chan 是你的……女朋友？还是只是碰巧是女生的普通朋友？

lines.en: : She’s just a friend. I don’t really know anything about romance and stuff.
lines.zh: : 她就是朋友。我对恋爱什么的真的一窍不通。

lines.en: : Maybe it’s different here, but I’m still kind of young where I’m from.
lines.zh: : 也许这里不一样，但在我来的地方，我还算小。

lines.en: : Told you she wasn’t sexually mature yet. Always trust the octopus.
lines.zh: : 我说了吧，她还没性成熟。永远相信章鱼。

lines.en: : Tell you what! How about you and I step outside to get some air and escape from all the noise? I can help you look around for one of those portal things.
lines.zh: : 这样吧！不如你跟我出去透透气，躲开这些吵闹？我可以帮你在附近找找那种传送门。

lines.en: : And, in the unfortunate event that we’re unable to find one, we can figure out where to go from there.
lines.zh: : 而万一我们找不到，再一起想下一步怎么办。

lines.en: : Worst case scenario, I give you a ride to the airport in the morning. {i}And,{/i} if it helps you avoid getting in trouble, you can just tell your sister I kidnapped you or something. I don’t mind if she hates me.
lines.zh: : 最坏的情况，明早我开车送你去机场。{i}而且{/i}，要是这能帮你免于挨骂，你就跟你姐姐说是我绑架你好了。她恨我我也不介意。

lines.en: scene chinamisnewfriend21
: Big sis Chika wouldn’t hate you. If anything, she’d be really happy that you helped me. She’s awesome! And maybe, if the portal is still here, she can come to your next party too?
lines.zh: : Chika 姐姐不会恨你的。相反，她会很高兴你帮了我。她超棒的！而且，要是传送门还在，她也能来你下一场派对？

lines.en: : Yeah! The more, the merrier. I can bring one of my sisters too so she can have a date. We’ll make a whole thing out of it.
lines.zh: : 好啊！人越多越热闹。我也可以带一个妹妹来，好让她有个伴。我们把这事办成一场大活动。

lines.en: : Hailey-
lines.zh: : Hailey——

lines.en: : Don’t even think about it, Paul. Nobody likes a cockblock.
lines.zh: : 想都别想，Paul。没人喜欢碍事的人。

lines.en: : Again, ignore them. Just come with me so everybody can stop interrupting us. Portal-hunt, go!
lines.zh: : 再说一遍，别理他们。跟我走吧，好让大家都别再来打断我们。找门行动，出发！

lines.en: scene chinamisnewfriend22
: Portal-hunt, go!
lines.zh: : 找门行动，出发！

lines.en: scene black
: You might have to tell me what they look like, though. I’ve never seen a portal in person before.
lines.zh: : 不过你可能得告诉我它们长什么样。我从没亲眼见过传送门。

lines.en: : Neither had Chinami until- mm!
lines.zh: : Chinami 之前也没见过，直到——嗯！

lines.en: : Hahahaha! You don’t need to stop yourself, Chinami! It’s totally fine. And like, totally adorable too.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈！你不用憋着自己，Chinami！完全没关系。而且，还特别可爱。

lines.en: : Look at him sighing as if he ever had a chance with her in the first place.
lines.zh: : 瞧他叹气的样子，好像他本来就有机会似的。

lines.en: : Yeah, this was done and dusted the second Hailey found out she wasn’t from around here. Exactly her type too.
lines.zh: : 是啊，Hailey 一发现她不是本地人，这事就板上钉钉了。而且正好是她喜欢的类型。

lines.en: : What, young and oblivious?
lines.zh: : 什么，年轻又懵懂？

lines.en: : I’d say {i}inexperienced{/i} is more politically correct. But yeah, pretty much.
lines.zh: : 我觉得说{i}没经验{/i}更政治正确一点。不过对，差不多。

lines.en: : I don’t know. Hailey seemed different this time. Maybe she actually likes her?
lines.zh: : 我倒不这么看。Hailey 这次看起来不一样。也许她是真的喜欢她？

lines.en: : You say that every time, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你每次都这么说，不是吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, and I’m usually right. It’s not {i}my{/i} fault she subsequently {i}stops{/i} liking them shortly afterward.
lines.zh: : 是啊，而且我通常是对的。她「后来」{i}不再{/i}喜欢人家，可不是{i}我{/i}的错。

lines.en: : She probably gets it from you.
lines.zh: : 她大概是随你。

lines.en: : Seriously, Paul. Just get the fuck over me already.
lines.zh: : 说真的，Paul。你就不能他妈放下我吗。

lines.en: scene chinamisnewfriend23
: Sorry we couldn’t find one of those portals, Chinami. Can you maybe just {i}call{/i} your sister and explain what’s going on?
lines.zh: : 抱歉没能找到那种传送门，Chinami。你要不要干脆{i}打{/i}给你姐姐，解释一下情况？

lines.en: : My phone doesn’t get any service here. International roaming plans don’t make much sense when your city is closed off from the rest of the world.
lines.zh: : 我的手机在这儿没信号。当你的城市与世隔绝时，国际漫游套餐没什么意义。

lines.en: : Yeah, I can imagine. I hope you’re able to get back safe. I don’t really know the situation over there.
lines.zh: : 是啊，能想象。希望你能平安回去。我对那边的情况真不太了解。

lines.en: : Do you like living in Japan? I’ve always wanted to see Mt. Fuji. What’s it like in person?
lines.zh: : 你喜欢住在日本吗？我一直想去看富士山。亲眼看到是什么感觉？

lines.en: scene chinamisnewfriend24
: I’ve actually never seen it. But maybe when the walls are down one day, I can take a trip there and take some pictures.
lines.zh: : 其实我从没见过。不过也许等有一天墙倒了，我可以去那儿走走，拍几张照片。

lines.en: : With your friend, Nao-chan?
lines.zh: : 和你的朋友 Nao-chan 一起？

lines.en: : I have other friends too. Well, one other friend. Her name is Tsukasa and she’s super rich.
lines.zh: : 我还有别的朋友。嗯，还有一个朋友。她叫 Tsukasa，超级有钱。

lines.en: : Aww, just {i}one{/i} other friend? Have I not made the cut?
lines.zh: : 哎呀，就{i}一个{/i}别的朋友？我还不够格吗？

lines.en: scene chinamisnewfriend25
: I like you too, Hailey. But why would you even want to be friends with somebody like me? I live so far away and we might not ever see each other again.
lines.zh: : Chinami 也喜欢你，Hailey。可你为什么会想跟 Chinami 这样的人做朋友呢？我住得那么远，我们可能再也见不到面了。

lines.en: : Hahah, yeah. I guess you’re right about that. I don’t really know, though. Like, I’m just...I don’t know. You’re {i}interesting.{/i} I don’t talk to dogs much.
lines.zh: : 哈哈，是啊。这点你大概说得对。不过我真的不知道。就是……我不知道。你很「{i}有意思{/i}」。我不太跟狗说话。

lines.en: : I get it. I don’t talk to rabbits much. You’re the first one, actually.
lines.zh: : 我懂。我不太跟兔子说话。你其实是第一个。

lines.en: : I’ve got some bad news then.
lines.zh: : 那我有个坏消息。

lines.en: : It’s not about the World Trade Center, is it?
lines.zh: : 不会是世界贸易中心那件事吧？

lines.en: : No. Just that I’m not actually a rabbit. I’m a hare.
lines.zh: : 不是。只是我其实不是兔子。我是野兔。

lines.en: scene chinamisnewfriend26
: Oh, really? I hope I didn’t offend you. I don’t really know the difference between those two things.
lines.zh: : 哦，真的吗？希望我没冒犯你。我真不太清楚这两者的区别。

lines.en: : It’s totally fine, hahah! Not many people do. But hares have longer ears and legs and are basically just, like...bigger, cooler rabbits.
lines.zh: : 完全没关系，哈哈！没多少人知道。不过野兔耳朵和腿更长，基本上就是……更大、更酷的兔子。

lines.en: : Really, the only thing rabbits have on us is their sex drive. They reproduce like {i}way{/i} more often since their gestation period is like 50%% faster or something like that.
lines.zh: : 真的，兔子唯一比我们强的就是性欲。它们繁殖频率{i}高{/i}得多，因为妊娠期大概快 50%% 什么的。

lines.en: scene chinamisnewfriend27
: Can you even imagine? Like, you have sex {i}one{/i} time and boom. Thirty days later, you’ve got like ten kits hopping around.
lines.zh: : 你能想象吗？比如，你做{i}一次{/i}爱，然后砰。三十天后，你就有十只小兔在蹦跶了。

lines.en: : No wonder you have so many sisters.
lines.zh: : 难怪你有那么多姐妹。

lines.en: : You can borrow some if you’d like. I have more than enough to share.
lines.zh: : 你想借几个也行。我多的是，分你点不碍事。

lines.en: scene chinamisnewfriend28
: I’m happy with the sister I have. She can just be a little crazy sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我有我这个姐姐就够了。她就是有时候有点疯。

lines.en: : Really? How so?
lines.zh: : 真的？怎么说？

lines.en: : Just boy stuff mostly. She was fine until she fell in love. Now, she’s always freaking out about romance for a bunch of different reasons I don’t really understand.
lines.zh: : 基本上就是男生的事。她谈恋爱之前还好好的。现在老是为一堆 Chinami 不太懂的原因，为恋爱的事发疯。

lines.en: : Yeah, romance will do that to a person. My oldest sister was the same when she met her husband. And now they’re talking about having kids of their own, so I’m sure she’ll get even {i}crazier.{/i}
lines.zh: : 是啊，恋爱会把人变成那样。我大姐遇到她丈夫时也是这样。现在他们还在说要生孩子，所以我敢肯定她会{i}更疯{/i}。

lines.en: scene chinamisnewfriend29
: Do you have a boyfriend, Hailey? You seem too cool to {i}not{/i} have one. Maybe you can give my big sister some tips on how to stay that way?
lines.zh: : Hailey，你有男朋友吗？你这么酷，不{i}可能{/i}没有吧？也许你能教教我姐姐怎么保持这状态？

lines.en: : Hm? No, I don’t have a boyfriend. I’m a lesbian.
lines.zh: : 嗯？没有，我没有男朋友。我是同性恋。

lines.en: scene chinamisnewfriend30
: Well...I guess I’m bisexual {i}technically.{/i} But I’ve only ever dated girls before. It’s just easier, you know?
lines.zh: : 嗯……「{i}严格来说{/i}」我应该算双性恋。不过我以前只跟女生交往过。就是更省事，你懂吧？

lines.en: : Easier? How so?
lines.zh: : 省事？怎么说？

lines.en: : Well, I don’t ever have to worry about suddenly having kids. So that’s a plus.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我永远不用担心突然有了孩子。这算个好处。

lines.en: : But there’s just something inherently easier about dating another you, I think. Especially if they’re around the same age and use the same makeup and stuff.
lines.zh: : 不过我觉得，跟另一个「你」交往，本质上就是更省事一点。尤其是如果你们年纪相仿，用的化妆品也差不多什么的。

lines.en: : Do hares even use makeup?
lines.zh: : 野兔也化妆吗？

lines.en: scene chinamisnewfriend31
: Of course we do. Just look at my eyeliner. Now, imagine a world where that eyeliner belongs to an ex and you didn’t even have to pay for it. Kablam. You just saved five dollars.
lines.zh: : 当然化。看看我的眼线就知道了。现在，想象一个世界：那道眼线属于前任，而且你连钱都不用花。咔嚓。你省了五美元。

lines.en: : It’s kind of hard to see in the dark.
lines.zh: : 在黑暗里有点难看清。

lines.en: scene chinamisnewfriend32
: Here, get a closer look. Can you see it {i}now?{/i} Do you bear witness to my sexually-driven frugality?
lines.zh: : 来，凑近点看。你「{i}现在{/i}」看到了吗？你可曾见证我那受性欲驱动的节俭？

lines.en: : Oh, okay. Chinami can see it now. She thinks saving money on eyeliner is a strange reason to like girls, though.
lines.zh: : 哦，好的。Chinami 现在看到了。不过她觉得，为了省眼线钱而喜欢女生，是个挺奇怪的理由。

lines.en: scene chinamisnewfriend33
: Well, it’s obviously not {i}just{/i} that. It’s just...I don’t know. I’ve {i}always{/i} been attracted to girls.
lines.zh: : 嗯，显然不{i}只是{/i}那个。只是……我不知道。我{i}一直{/i}都对女生有感觉。

lines.en: : It’s hard to keep my heart steady when I encounter somebody I find pretty. And I’m not only saying that because my resting heart rate is like three times the speed of a dog’s.
lines.zh: : 遇到我觉得漂亮的人，心跳就很难稳住。而且我这么说，不单是因为我的静息心率差不多是狗的三倍。

lines.en: : Do you get what I’m saying, though? Like, have you ever met anybody who makes your heart beat faster?
lines.zh: : 不过你懂我的意思吗？就是，你有没有遇到过哪个让你心跳加速的人？

lines.en: : Not yet. But Chinami hasn’t met many people at all yet, so she’s not even sure what kind of person she likes.
lines.zh: : 还没有。但 Chinami 根本还没见过多少人，所以她甚至不确定自己喜欢什么样的人。

lines.en: : How about this Nao-chan girl?
lines.zh: : 那这个 Nao-chan 呢？

lines.en: scene chinamisnewfriend34
: But Chinami already said that Nao-chan is just a friend.
lines.zh: : 可 Chinami 说了，Nao-chan 只是朋友。

lines.en: : Sure. But you can be friends with somebody and still want to {i}be{/i} with them. You know what I mean?
lines.zh: : 当然。但你可以跟一个人做朋友，同时还是想跟她{i}在一起{/i}。你懂我意思吧？

lines.en: : Like you and me for example. If we kissed right now, it’s not like we’d just graduate from being friends all of a sudden. We’d just be...you know. Acting on an impulse.
lines.zh: : 比如你和我。就算我们现在接吻，也不代表我们就突然从朋友「毕业」了。我们只是……你知道。顺从一次冲动。

lines.en: : Chinami doesn’t know how to kiss, though. So she thinks you’d probably start hating her and not want to be her friend anymore.
lines.zh: : 可 Chinami 不会接吻。所以她觉得，你大概过不了多久就会开始讨厌她，不想再跟她做朋友了。

lines.en: : You’re pretty much exclusively stuck in third person now. Can I take that as you being more comfortable with me?
lines.zh: : 你现在基本整个人都卡在第三人称里了。我能把这当作你跟我更自在了吗？

lines.en: scene chinamisnewfriend35
: Mhm! Chinami knows you don’t want to hurt her and won’t make fun of her, so she doesn’t mind if she makes speaking mistakes now.
lines.zh: : 嗯！Chinami 知道你不会伤害她，也不会笑话她，所以现在就算说错了话她也不介意了。

lines.en: : Don’t call them mistakes. They’re {i}impulses.{/i} Just {i}wanting{/i} to do something doesn’t automatically make it wrong. Especially if it’s something small like a name.
lines.zh: : 别叫它们「错」。那是{i}冲动{/i}。光是{i}想{/i}做什么，并不自动就是错的。尤其是像名字这种小事。

lines.en: : Or a kiss?
lines.zh: : 或者一个吻？

lines.en: : Exactly.
lines.zh: : 正是。

lines.en: scene chinamisnewfriend36
: Chinami thinks she understands now. And she’s glad she has somebody like Hailey to teach her.
lines.zh: : Chinami 觉得她现在明白了。她很高兴能有 Hailey 这样的人来教她。

lines.en: : And Hailey’s glad she has somebody like Chinami to make her feel a little less alone.
lines.zh: : 而 Hailey 很高兴能有 Chinami 这样的人，让她觉得没那么孤单。

lines.en: : Mm...you’re really warm. And soft...
lines.zh: : 嗯……你好暖。好软……

lines.en: : Do you ever get scared, Chinami?
lines.zh: : Chinami，你有过害怕的时候吗？

lines.en: : Of what?
lines.zh: : 怕什么？

lines.en: : {i}This.{/i}
: Getting close to someone you know you shouldn’t. The paths your mind leads you down that you {i}know{/i} are wrong, but there’s just something so...exciting and {i}new{/i} about it.
lines.zh: : 靠近一个你明知道不该靠近的人。你的思绪把你引向那些你{i}知道{/i}是错的路，可就是有什么东西那么……刺激，那么{i}新鲜{/i}。

lines.en: : Chinami has a friend who keeps trying to show her {i}exciting{/i} and {i}new{/i} things too. But all they really do is make Chinami nervous.
lines.zh: : Chinami 也有个朋友，老是想给她看{i}刺激{/i}又{i}新鲜{/i}的东西。可它们真的只会让 Chinami 紧张。

lines.en: : What kind of things?
lines.zh: : 什么样的东西？

lines.en: : Things that even Chinami’s older sister doesn’t want to teach her about.
lines.zh: : 那种连 Chinami 的姐姐都不想教她的事。

lines.en: : Like things that adults do?
lines.zh: : 比如大人才做的事？

lines.en: : Mhm. And that {i}is{/i} kind of scary, so she thinks she understands what you’re trying to say.
lines.zh: : 嗯。而那{i}确实{/i}有点吓人，所以她觉得她懂你想说什么了。

lines.en: : You know...
lines.zh: : 你知道嘛……

lines.en: : The best way to stop being scared of something is to face it head on.
lines.zh: : 不再害怕某件事最好的办法，就是正面迎上去。

lines.en: scene chinamisnewfriend37
: Head on?...
: Mhm...
: Like, for example, kissing is probably really scary to you right now since you’ve never done it before. But it’d be a lot less scary if you understood that it was safe, right?
lines.zh: : 比如，接吻现在对你来说大概特别可怕，因为你从没做过。但要是你明白它是安全的，就没那么可怕了，对吧？

lines.en: : I guess so...That makes sense.
lines.zh: : 我想是吧……有道理。

lines.en: : Then...
lines.zh: : 那么……

lines.en: : Maybe you’d want to practice with me?
lines.zh: : 也许你愿意跟我练习一下？

lines.en: scene chinamisnewfriend38
: Sorry! Sorry. That was stupid. Of course you wouldn’t want to practice with me. Like, what am I even saying? Hahahah!
lines.zh: : 抱歉！抱歉。那太蠢了。你当然不会想跟我练习。我都在说什么啊。哈哈哈！

lines.en: : Nobody’s ever wanted to kiss Chinami before. She’s not sure how to respond.
lines.zh: : 从来没有人想吻过 Chinami。她不知道该怎么回应。

lines.en: : Well...
lines.zh: : 那个……

lines.en: : Does Chinami want to kiss Hailey? Just to...you know...see what it’s like?
lines.zh: : Chinami 想吻 Hailey 吗？就只是……你知道……看看是什么感觉？

lines.en: : Unless you already know that you don’t like girls {i}at all,{/i} which is totally fair. Like, I’m not trying to pressure you or anything. I just...yeah.
lines.zh: : 除非你已经确定自己{i}完全{/i}不喜欢女生，那也完全合理。我不是在逼你什么的。我只是……嗯。

lines.en: : I want to kiss you.
lines.zh: : 我想吻你。

lines.en: : Your mouth. Your neck. Your hands. Everywhere. I have since the moment I saw you. And I’m sorry for keeping that a secret, but-
lines.zh: : 你的嘴。你的脖子。你的手。每一处。从见到你的那一刻起我就想。抱歉我一直瞒着，可是——

lines.en: : Okay.
: O...Okay?
lines.zh: : 好……好吗？

lines.en: : You can kiss Chinami.
lines.zh: : 你可以吻 Chinami。

lines.en: : But only for a little while, okay?
lines.zh: : 但只能吻一小会儿，好吗？

lines.en: : And only because you made her heart beat really fast just now.
lines.zh: : 而且只因为你刚才让她心跳得特别快。

lines.en: : Okay...
: Eyes...closed? Or open? Closed helps with the nerves.
lines.zh: : 眼睛……闭上？还是睁开？闭上能缓解紧张。

lines.en: scene black
: Chinami will close her eyes then...But also! You need to keep this a secret from her big sister! Chinami thinks she’d get in trouble if she found out she kissed a hare.
lines.zh: : 那 Chinami 会闭上眼睛……不过还有！这事得保密，不能让她姐姐知道！Chinami 觉得，要是被发现她吻了一只野兔，她会挨骂的。

lines.en: : Yeah, don’t worry. I’ve had plenty of girls tell me the exact same thing.
lines.zh: : 嗯，别担心。有好多女孩跟我说过一模一样的话。

lines.en: : Be calm, okay?...
lines.zh: : 放松，好吗？……

lines.en: : I’ll start slow...
lines.zh: : 我会慢慢来……

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 可是……

lines.en: : Please forgive me if I can’t control myself after a few seconds.
lines.zh: : 如果几秒后我控制不住自己，请原谅我。

lines.en: scene chinamisnewfriend44
: YOU THERE! EMPLOYEE GIRL! I know you’re hiding things from me. LET ME IN THE BACK ROOM! NOW!
lines.zh: : 那边那个！店员小姐！我知道你们在藏东西。让我进后面的房间！现在！

lines.en: : What do you mean it’s for employees only?! If I have to get a job here, I will! Where’s the fucking manager?! WHERE?!
lines.zh: : 什么叫只有员工才能进？！要是我非得在这儿找份工作，我就找！那该死的经理在哪儿？！在哪儿？！

lines.en: scene chinamisnewfriend45
: Fine! {i}Call{/i} the fucking police! See if they can stop me! See if- AAAH! YOU! LITTLE GIRL! GET THE FUCK AWAY FROM THAT BOX SET! THAT’S MINE!
lines.zh: : 好！「{i}叫{/i}」那该死的警察来吧！看他们能不能拦住我！看我——啊！你！小丫头！离那套盒装专辑远点！那是我的！
